point.title: 人称代词和物主代词
point.summary: 人称代词:作主语用主格(I/we/he…),作宾语或表语用宾格(me/us/him…);单独作答或带 not 的简短回答常用宾格(—Who is it? —Me.);it 可表时间/天气/距离;并列顺序 you, he and I。物主代词:形容词性(my/our/your/his/her/its/their)用在名词前;名词性(mine/ours/yours/his/hers/its/theirs)独立使用,代替“形容词性+名词”。
point.examples: He doesn't believe me. / It's a fine day today. / The red one is yours (= your pen). / May I use your pen? Yours works better.

questions.stem: ____ am a middle school student now.
questions.explanation: 作主语用主格 I。

questions.stem: My grandpa often tells ____ interesting stories.
questions.explanation: 作宾语用宾格 me。

questions.stem: ____ school uniform is blue and white.
questions.explanation: 名词 school uniform 前用形容词性物主代词 my。

questions.stem: Tom is my classmate. ____ is good at maths.
questions.explanation: 作主语用主格 He；He's=He is。

questions.stem: This blue pen isn't yours. It's ____.
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 mine 代替 my pen。

questions.stem: Our teacher helps ____ with English every day.
questions.explanation: 作宾语用宾格 us。

questions.stem: ____ is sunny and warm today.
questions.explanation: it 可表天气。

questions.stem: — Is this schoolbag ____? — Yes, it's mine.
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 yours 代替 your schoolbag；you're=you are。

questions.stem: The students are cleaning ____ classroom.
questions.explanation: 名词 classroom 前用形容词性物主代词 their。

questions.stem: — Who broke the window? — ____.
questions.explanation: 单独作答常用宾格 Me；主格一般不单独使用。

questions.stem: Lily loves ____ new bike very much.
questions.explanation: 名词 bike 前用形容词性物主代词 her。

questions.stem: The little dog is wagging ____ tail happily.
questions.explanation: its 表示“它的”；it's=it is。

questions.stem: These gloves are ____, not mine.
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 hers 代替 her gloves；无 her's 写法。

questions.stem: We are all proud of ____ school.
questions.explanation: 名词 school 前用形容词性物主代词 our。

questions.stem: When several pronouns are used together, English usually says ____.
questions.explanation: 英语人称代词并列顺序为 you, he and I。

questions.stem: It's about 20 kilometres from my home to school. ____ takes an hour by bus.
questions.explanation: it 可表距离，且 It takes… 表花费时间。

questions.stem: The books are heavy. Can you help me carry ____?
questions.explanation: 作宾语用宾格 them。

questions.stem: This is Peter's eraser. The eraser is ____.
questions.explanation: his 既可作形容词性也可作名词性物主代词,此处名词性,代替 his eraser。

questions.stem: My sister and I share a room. That bed by the window is ____.
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 mine 代替 my bed。

questions.stem: Welcome to our school! Nice to meet ____!
questions.explanation: meet 后作宾语用宾格 you。
